coverage: every argument word covered exactly once; unused metadata zero
scalar: one u32 or constant_bytes/4 consecutive words, each within min..max
address: zero placeholder replaced by admitted object GPU32 address + ref.offset + optional relative scalar
extent: constant_bytes + element_bytes * product(validated scalar counts); overflow and reference bounds rejected
counts: only SCALAR32 fields may supply counts or relative offset
code_rodata_crt_stack: explicit trusted fixed GPU32 locations, independently checked against address pools, reservations and live objects; never inferred from file offsets
private_state: args, CRT and stack explicitly zeroed and read back before CPU aliases are sealed
job_reference_count: 8 DATA refs; args and code/rodata/private program objects are separate pinned references
